derivation.onset: Section 6.2: earliest signed, unattributed Grade >=1 observation is ICE 7/10 on 25 Aug = Day 5 (Grade 1). Fever is CRS and never a competing cause (A35), and the clinician attributes the drop to ICANS (A9). Record Day 5 equals documented Day 5, so 7.7 (section 7.7, zero tolerance, A4).
derivation.max_grade: Section 3.3 / 3.4: ICE 5/10 (Grade 2) and awakens to voice (Grade 2) on Day 7 are the worst findings; no seizure, motor or ICP finding. Documented Grade 2 equals record Grade 2, so 7.7.

ambiguity_notes: Fever and CRS are present when the ICE fell, but A35 says CRS and fever are never competing causes, and tocilizumab, acetaminophen and dexamethasone are treatment, not competing causes. Both notes also carry explicit clinician statements attributing the ICE drop to ICANS. No second reading changes either category. Only the Day 4 ICE 10/10 precedes the onset.
